svg.title: Pundoku — вордмарк D4
svg.desc: Drawn letters, not a font: monoline stroke 22, cap height 104, x-height 76 for every lowercase letter including u and n, counters are circles. No glyph of any typeface is embedded, so there is no licence question. Zero letter modifications — "Pun" is set apart by colour alone (round 2's modified n was its own weakness). The u carries a full-height right stem (a spur) so it can never be read as a mirrored n.
